summary: The filing is a Form 6-K by U Power Ltd providing notice and proxy statement for an extraordinary general meeting scheduled for May 19, 2026. The proposals include an increase of authorized share capital, adoption of an amended memorandum and articles of association, and a share consolidation. This is a routine corporate governance matter and does not constitute a special situation. The registrant is simply filing the meeting materials as required for a foreign private issuer. No acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, strategic review, tender offer, going-private transaction, or other special situation is described.
